Ἐφραὶμ ὁ Νεομάρτυς is the epithet of the Nea Makri saint (1384-1426) whose type this folder gives as venerable-martyr, and is not borne by Ephraim the Syrian. Commons describes it: Saint Ephraim the Neomartyr (Church of Panagia Theotokos - Vouliagmenis Avenue).
